args.title: Ignore trailing blank lines when parsing statements
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

parseStatement only strips a single trailing empty string left by a final newline, but statements that end with an actual blank line after the last transaction leave one more empty line in `lines`, which then fails assertShape as a malformed row. Change the trailing-line handling to strip all trailing blank lines (or skip blank lines generally while iterating data rows) so files with a blank line after the last transaction parse successfully.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

parseStatement only trims a single trailing empty string (from the final newline). A statement with a genuine blank line after the last transaction leaves one more empty line, which then fails the column-count check in assertShape and raises errors.rowShape at the row just past the data. The fix is to strip all trailing blank lines (or skip blank lines while iterating) instead of popping just one.
